title: HBAI-Ltd/Toonflow-app
claim: HBAI-Ltd/Toonflow-app — Toonflow 是开源一站式 AI 短剧创作工具，将小说、剧本快速转化为动画短剧。集成 AI 编剧、智能分镜、角色与视频生成，跨平台桌面端轻量部署，助力创作者低成本批量产出视觉内容。Toonflow is an open-source A
why_good: Turns novels/scripts into animated short dramas with AI (writing, storyboard, character + video gen) — riding China's booming short-drama economy where volume and cost matter.
value: 短剧工作室 and 小说 IP holders who already pay per generated second — they pay for the step that stops wasting those seconds: a shot list that survives to the last panel.
risk: 剪映 or 可灵 bundling storyboard generation natively; nine contributors carrying a 13k-star repo.

zh.claim: HBAI-Ltd/Toonflow-app —— 开源一站式 AI 短剧创作工具,把小说/剧本快速转成动画短剧(AI 编剧、智能分镜、角色与视频生成),跨平台桌面轻量部署。
zh.why_good: 用 AI 把小说/剧本变成动画短剧(编剧、分镜、角色+视频生成)——踩在中国爆火的短剧经济上,量和成本正是关键。
zh.value: 已经在按秒为生成付费的短剧工作室与小说 IP 方——他们愿意为「不再浪费这些秒」的那一步买单：一张能撑到最后一格的分镜表。
zh.risk: 剪映或可灵原生集成分镜生成；1.3 万星的仓库只靠 9 位贡献者撑着。
zh.hook: 中文短剧团队真的在拿它出片，然后卡在最要命的一步：分镜表生成到一半被截断、分镜图 prompt 是空的、docker 部署卡到没法用——他们已经在为生成付费，只是这一步一直不成。
zh.does: 开源桌面应用，把小说或剧本一路带到动画短剧：AI 编剧 → 分镜表与分镜图 → 角色与图像生成 → 视频合成，全程用你自己的模型 key。跨平台、部署轻量，几周内 1.3 万星。
zh.gap: 它击中了真痛点但解得不完美，而且恰恰断在最关键的一环：剧本 → 分镜表 → 提示词会被截断，还会「成功写入」却一条都看不到，创作者只能盯着 token 上限反复重跑。此外它实际只服务中文用户——一个英文用户连登录弹窗都过不去。
zh.counter: 这是板上最吃资本的一条：每一秒成片都在烧模型钱，而可灵 / 即梦 / 海螺 同时握着模型和分发——字节把整条流水线塞进剪映，一夜之间就能把独立开发者挤出价格。1.3 万星背后只有 9 位贡献者，bus factor 是 1。整条流水线正是标准里排除的「烧钱抢速度」赛道，对你开放的只有其中很窄、纯文本的一刀。
zh.differentiator: 别做流水线。做那个一直坏、又几乎不花钱的环节：一个绝不截断的「小说 → 分镜表」转换器（分块、可续跑、结构校验），并把每个镜头的干净提示词导出到可灵 / 即梦 / Runway——按剧本卖给那些本来就在别处为生成付费的短剧工作室。
zh.consumer_angle: 它本来就是创作者产品：买家是小型短剧工作室，不是开发者。

zh.edge: 它的终点是一集能播的成片，而不是一堆素材——剧本、分镜、角色、视频，在桌面上一次走完。
zh.why_use: 写网文的人不是剪辑师。从写完一章到做出一集能看的片子，中间横着一条他们根本没办法自己走的生产线。

pick_reason: The project is an open-source tool that lacks a clear monetization strategy and is too similar to existing solutions.

does: An open-source desktop app that carries a novel or script all the way to an animated short drama: AI screenwriting → shot list and storyboard → character and image generation → video assembly, driven by your own model keys. Cross-platform, light deploy, 13k stars in weeks.
gap: It hits a real pain but solves it imperfectly, and it breaks at exactly the step that matters: script → shot list → prompts truncates and silently writes empty panels, so the operator babysits token limits and re-runs. There is also no version for anyone outside 中文 — an English user could not get past the login dialog.
counter: This is the most capital-exposed entry on the board: every second of output costs model money, and 可灵 / 即梦 / 海螺 own both the model and the distribution — ByteDance can fold the whole pipeline into 剪映 and price an indie out overnight. 13k stars sit on nine contributors, so the bus factor is one. The full pipeline is precisely the burn-money-for-speed race the standard excludes; only a narrow, text-only slice of it is open to you.
differentiator: Do not build the pipeline. Build the one step that keeps breaking and costs almost nothing to run: a 小说 → 分镜表 converter that never truncates (chunked, resumable, schema-validated) and exports clean, per-shot prompts into 可灵 / 即梦 / Runway — sold per script to the 短剧工作室 who are already paying for generation somewhere else.
consumer_angle: Already a creator product: the buyer is the small 短剧 studio, not a developer.
edge: It ends at a finished animated episode, not at a pile of assets — script, storyboard, characters and video in one pass on the desktop.
why_use: The people writing web novels are not video editors. Between a finished chapter and a watchable episode sits a production pipeline they have no way to run.
